cohort: The study included 79 neonates with hemolytic disease of the newborn (HDN) born to blood group O mothers with ABO and Rh incompatibility, reviewed from medical records between 2017 and 2020.
finding: IVIG administration significantly reduced mean total bilirubin levels in treated neonates compared to non-IVIG-treated neonates, suggesting its utility in managing bilirubin encephalopathy and potentially reducing exchange transfusion requirements.
